cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not Why We Drifted
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation away from the real reason the relationship changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I've found our wedding video. Shall we watch it?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd rather discuss why we're living separately.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Here's your father's speech. We never could agree what he meant by 'good luck'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He meant exactly this. Pause it. I don't want another speech.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paused. Let's skip to the dancing, then. No speeches. You can help me settle whether your uncle actually falls into the cake.
